जृभ् जृभ् or जृम्भ्, cl. 1. A. (poet. also
P.) जृम्भते, -ति, or जर्भते, जजृम्भे,
जृम्भिष्यते, जृम्भितुम्, to open the mouth, yawn,
gape; to gape open, open (as a flower), burst open; fly
back or recoil (as a bow); to unfold, spread, extend,
expand, occupy a larger circuit; to spread (as sound);
to feel at ease: Caus. जृम्भयति, -यितुम्, to
cause to gape or yawn, cause to expand or unfold;
[cf. Old Germ. chliupu, ‘to split;’ Germ. klaffe,
kluft; Goth. graba; Germ. grabe; Gr. γράφω;
Hib. grabhaim, grafain, grafan; cf. also 1. जभ्.]

जृभ् or जृम्भ्; add — to unbend or unstring a
bow.
